BillHeading.BriefDescription: Modifying the qualifications of members composing the county road administration board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying the qualifications of members composing the county road administration board; and amending RCW 36.78.040.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 36.78.040 and 2005 c 233 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Composition of board—Qualifications of members.
BillSection.P: Six members of the county road administration board shall be county legislative authority members and three members shall be county engineers. If any member, during the term for which he or she is appointed, ceases to be either a member of a county legislative authority or a county engineer, as the case may be, his or her membership on the county road administration board is likewise terminated. Three members of the board shall be from counties with a population of one hundred twenty-five fifty thousand or more. Four members shall be from counties with a population of from twenty thirty thousand to less than one hundred twenty-five fifty thousand. Two members shall be from counties with a population of less than twenty thirty thousand. Not more than one member of the board shall be from any one county.
